recipes.name: Oh So Good Pork Chops
ingredients_raw: 1 (.75 ounce) packet dry brown gravy mix

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat, and brown the pork chops on both sides, 5 to 8 minutes per side.

Whisk together the water, brown gravy mix, brown sugar, vinegar, and garlic powder in a bowl until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is smooth. Pour the gravy mixture over the browned pork chops. Cover the skillet, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the chops are tender, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Oh So Good Pork Chops
raw_recipe.description: Pork chops simmer until tender in a sweet and tangy gravy in this easy, fast recipe.

review.reviewBody: This was a good recipe that I will use again. Since the recipe called for vinegar, I used Apple cider vinegar. I also love Garlic so i used fresh garlic not power. The sauce was great over mash potatos and stuffing.

This was a huge hit with my family. I doubled the gravy ingredients, then browned my chops and added them to the crockpot with the gravy. I cooked them for 5 hours on low. I added cornstarch at the very end to the thicken the sauce. Served with mashed potatoes, it is a winner!

I made this recipe again and this time I doubled the directions for the gravy and added an 11.5 ounce package of a brand name refrigerated pulled pork and let it simmer for about 20 minutes. I served it on hamburger buns. No leftovers! Thank you, Cooking Mama.

I followed the recipe and it was great. The only thing different was I could only cook 3 pork chops at a time. So after I fried them I put them in a 9x13 pan, then I thickened the sauce in the frying pan where I had the pork chops, poured the gravy over the chops covered with tin foil and stuck in oven on 350 for 30 minutes. Turned out great.

Made this tonight and it was a hit!! my daughter gave me a compliment so it had to be good lol i did change it a bit added a little milk to make it a bit more creamier and sliced up an onion and turned it in to smothered pork chops! very easy week night meal served it over yellow rice! i will make this again!!

We loved this. I made some changes. Used pork gravy pack,fresh garlic, a can of cream of mushroom,and a can of Franco America beef gravy. It was oh so good! Very very easy. Served with mash potato and corn. The pork was so tender. I will make this again, again and again. If you get my point. lol Enjoy people! :)

I tried this recipe last night for dinner and it was an absolute hit with my family. The only thing I will do different the next time is NOT add the brown sugar, I'm not a big fan of sweet sauce. I did add onions and mushrooms to my sauce and it was DELICIOUS!!!!!!!
I love this recipe! It's so easy to make and it's so delicious. I've made this recipe many times now and there is no need to change anything except maybe double the sauce because it's so good! 🥰

I tried this recipe "as is" and it was very good. The second time I made it I had forgotten the brown gravy mix, so I substitued i packet of Lipton Onion soup mix and it was fantastic! My family loved it and so did I.

I tried this recipe "as is" and it was very good. The second time I made it I had forgotten the brown gravy mix, so I substitued i packet of Lipton Onion soup mix and it was fantastic! My family loved it and so did I.

These porkchops are fork tender. I always double the gravy because I want plenty for my mashed potatoes. This is the best recipe for pork chops I've ever tried, my only regret is I didn't discover this recipe 10 years ago.
Wow delicious gravy. It was a hit. Thank you❤

I made this recipe and followed the recipe as it is written. It was delicious and very fast and easy! I will definitely make this again and again. The only thing I think I will try is adding some sauteed mushrooms and onions because I think that it would be a nice addition to the delicious sauce this recipe makes. Don't be afraid to try this one, you won't be sorry!
The chips were very very tender. They were quite good but I think could have used a little more season. I think I will add Adobo next time.

The meat was tender, and the flavor was ok, but nothing all that spectacular. I would make it again since it was so simple, but I'll probably continue on my search for a better simple pork chop recipe.

This was a great recipe! Los of flavour. I made it without any changes and it was a big hit with the family. It kind of had a German taste which we love and I will make again as it is so quick and easy.
5 stars because my kids also loved it. They are so darn picky! This recipe goes great with mashed potatoes!!
This was very tasty, my family and I enjoyed it. I used boneless pork loin chops. They stayed nice and moist. Will make again. Very easy too!
